process.title: Requirements & Planning
process.desc: I start with the business, the users and the goals — then break the work into a clear scope and sprint plan the whole team can follow.

process.title: System Design
process.desc: Architecture, database structure and API contracts are designed up front so the system scales and stays secure as it grows.

process.title: Build & Code Review

process.title: Testing & Optimization

process.title: Deploy & Support
process.desc: The product ships, and I stay close afterwards — monitoring, fixing and iterating with the client for long-term success.
